# BLUR BAND BB-v1 (exact; code frozen as returns/V5_EDGE_METRICS_v001.py sha 947198442c94a02497a54ae34b8337f9c6debdd31c250a961c37c5e569293b17; run: python3 V5_EDGE_METRICS_v001.py IMAGE x0,y0,x1,y1 --mask EXCL.png): L = PIL convert('L') luma as float; crop = box padded 12 px each side; ref = scipy.ndimage.median_filter(crop, size=21) (mode reflect); ink0 = (L < 0.60*ref) inside the box, minus --mask px; ink = ink0 minus 8-connected components < 4 px; soft = L < 0.80*ref; all dilations/erosions use the scipy default 4-connected cross; edge_in = ink & ~erode(ink,1); ring = dilate(ink,10) & ~dilate(ink,3) & ~mask & ~soft; inkL = median L over ink; skinL = median L over ring; C = skinL - inkL; near = dilate(ink,3) & ~erode(ink,1) & ~mask; trans = near px with inkL+0.2C < L < inkL+0.8C; BB = count(trans) / count(edge_in) [20-80% transition px per INNER edge px]. Difference from Z_1's proxy: Z_1 divides by OUTER edge px; BB-v1 divides by INNER edge px (ink px with a non-ink 4-neighbour) and counts transition px both inside the ink edge and up to 3 px outside. Companions in the same file: peak gradient = p90/max of hypot(sobel_x,sobel_y)/8 over inner+outer edge px, grad/C = p90/C; hard_step = share of outer-edge px already >= inkL+0.8C; halo = median L of the 1-2 px band (non-soft) / skinL - 1; fringe = median R-B and R-G on the outer edge vs ring and ink; mottle = std L over erode(ink,1).
